heard: A rocket exploded right under two sitting cosmonauts. It holds the record for the only crewed launch pad escape. A fuel leak during countdown turned their booster into a torch. Flames destroyed the wires for the escape tower. Controllers sent a backup radio signal to trigger it. The capsule yanked away at 17 times gravity's force. Six seconds later, the pad became a massive fireball. Shaken? The crew immediately disabled their voice recorder. They didn't want anyone hearing their swearing before ignition. That is how surviving destruction sounds.
